purpose: Public, secret-free handoff shape for an owner decision and independent review. This file is not an owner approval, authorization receipt, or execution command.
requiredBeforeHandoff: Owner identity and issuer are authenticated against a pre-declared trust root.
The owner decision is bound to every frozenBinding value and every non-null canonicalApprovalShape value.
targetRef and targetFingerprintSha256 identify a fresh disposable target that is absent before start.
snapshotSha256, snapshotRefSha256, and keyRefSha256 bind the same pre-existing encrypted snapshot copy.
The approval window is short, single-use, and expires before any later retry.
An independent reviewer verifies the payload, provenance, scope, and expiry through a separate trust path.
Only public signed envelopes and secret-free manifests are handed off; private keys, plaintext snapshots, passwords, and connection material stay out of this workspace.
forbiddenContents: private keys or signing seed material
passwords, access tokens, cookies, DSNs, or connection strings
plaintext snapshot bytes or decrypted database contents
production database credentials or production network endpoints
a self-generated approvalId, receiptId, or signature presented as owner authority
nextAction: Fill and authenticate this shape offline, then stage the public signed envelope together with e4-disconnected-snapshot-staging-manifest-template.v1.json. Do not rename this template to an executable receipt until a real verifier accepts the signature, trust root, provenance, binding, expiry, and one-shot consumption record.
